candidate.definition_en: Clothing worn under other clothes, next to the skin.
candidate.explanation_ar: الهدوم اللي بتتلبس تحت اللبس الخارجي وملاصقة للجسم.

senses.definition_en: Clothing worn under other clothes, next to the skin.
senses.explanation_ar: الهدوم اللي بتتلبس تحت اللبس الخارجي وملاصقة للجسم.
examples: Put on clean underwear every day.
He packed socks and underwear for the trip.
Thermal underwear is essential for skiing.
